title: How to Calculate How Many Tiles You Need (And Why You Need Extra)
summary:
Buying tile or flooring is a math puzzle.
You calculate the square footage, but you forget to add the 10-15% waste for cuts and breakage. You end up one box short, and the store is out of stock.
Let's look at how to automate this calculation using JavaScript.
Calculate the Area of the Room:
Length × Width = Total Square Feet


Calculate the Area of a Single Tile:
(Tile Length in inches × Tile Width in inches) ÷ 144 = Tile Square Feet


Divide Room Area by Tile Area:
Room Square Feet ÷ Tile Squar
